1. Choose the reference, the original of this image or another open image of the same size.
2. Add up the squared and absolute differences for MSE and MAE, and compute PSNR from MSE.
3. Blur the images, their squares and their product with a Gaussian of sigma 1.5.
4. Compute the SSIM map from these local moments and average it inside the frame.
